summary:
Complete creative rebuild verification for Apollo Builders (iteration 4). Backend: 5/5 pytest pass (health stubbed, POST/GET /api/enquiries, 422 validation, no _id leak). Frontend: all cinematic rebuild items verified at 1440x900. VERIFIED: (1) skip-nav a.skip-nav[href='#main'] present, main#main present, nav aria-label='Primary'. (2) Hero: hero-section renders with hero-heading text 'We build exceptional homes.', hero-cta uses btn-gold, hero-sub + hero-eyebrow present, hero contains 'Berwick-New-Build-5-e1762576152191.jpg' naturalWidth=1013. (3) 3D Scene: lazy Scene3D mounts inside hero-section at 1440px width after ~2s wait. (4) intro-section with 'Quality renovations & custom homes across Melbourne's South-East.' heading. (5) services-tiles with 4 tiles: new-home-builds, home-renovations, bathroom-renovations, kitchen-renovations. Hovering bathroom-renovations expands from 145px to 869px width and reveals 'Waterproofing' tagline. (6) featured-projects contains 6 project-{slug} articles (drouin-new-build, bentleigh-east-renovation, endeavour-hills-renovation, berwick-new-build, altona-meadows-renovation, clyde-new-build) — all images loading=lazy with naturalWidth>=1013 once scrolled into view. (7) why-us has exactly 6 numbered
  • items. (8) BlueprintProcess process-section renders 5 process-step-{0..4} items with inline SVG blueprint. (9) testimonials-section renders testimonial-{0..3} with author names Rosemarie Palazzolo, Lauren Blickley, Kristy Flanigen, James Lauber (rendered UPPERCASE via tracking-eyebrow CSS text-transform). (10) faq-section has 6 faq-item-{0..5} accordions — item 0 open→closed toggling verified via data-state attribute. (11) final-cta present with final-cta-btn.btn-gold. (12) Nav-cta correctly hidden at scrollY=0 on Home (overHero && !scrolled), appears after scroll 400px. (13) Nav-logo contains 'photo_2025-12-03_10-38-14-e1764907039294.png', naturalWidth=873. (14) Fonts: h1 computed = 'Fraunces, ui-serif, Georgia, serif'; hero-sub p = '"Inter Tight", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif'. (15) About /about renders about-page testid with hero 'We build carefully.'. (16) Services /services renders services-page; /services/kitchen-renovations highlights service-kitchen-renovations. (17) Contact /contact is dark-themed (bg=rgb(10,15,26)) with native
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx triggers a React console warning: 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority. Did you mean fetchPriority?' — cosmetic only, but should be renamed to camelCase fetchPriority to silence the warning.

Contact.jsx uses a native <select> for project_type — works correctly and is more robust than shadcn Select for form submissions, but note the option list has default 'Select a project type' placeholder that must be selected past before submit (server validates non-empty).
Scene3D is React.lazy — first paint of hero has no canvas for ~1.2–1.8s; consider a subtle skeleton or prewarming import on hover of hero to smooth perceived load.

Testimonial author names are transformed to UPPERCASE via the `tracking-eyebrow` utility (text-transform:uppercase). This is intentional editorial styling — automated content-match tests must normalize case.

BlueprintProcess uses gsap ScrollTrigger + Lenis smooth scroll simultaneously — verified functional, but if any future scroll-jack bugs appear, ensure ScrollTrigger.refresh() is called after Lenis initialisation.
brand.logo still hotlinks from apollobuilders.com.au CDN — same note as iteration 3: consider caching to /public to remove third-party dependency.
seed_data_creation: TEST_ enquiries created via API pytest (TEST_John Doe) and via contact form (TEST_Playwright Cinematic 3).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All rebuild items verified at https://premium-apollo.preview.emergentagent.com. Key testids: hero-section, hero-heading, hero-cta, hero-sub, hero-eyebrow, intro-section, services-tiles, service-tile-{slug}, featured-projects, project-{slug}, why-us, process-section, process-step-{0..4}, testimonials-section, testimonial-{0..3}, faq-section, faq-item-{0..5}, final-cta, final-cta-btn, nav-logo, nav-cta, about-page, services-page, service-{slug}, contact-page, input-{name|phone|email|address|project-type|message}, submit-enquiry, thanks. GOTCHAS: (a) project images use loading='lazy' — scroll gradually before asserting naturalWidth>0 on altona/clyde. (b) hero canvas needs ~1.5–2s wait after page load because Scene3D is React.lazy and only mounts at viewport >=900px with prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference. (c) input-project-type is a NATIVE <select> — use page.select_option not shadcn portal role='option'. (d) testimonial author names are UPPERCASE via CSS — case-insensitive match required. (e) React console warning about lowercase 'fetchpriority' — cosmetic, harmless.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Initial Playwright script produced 8 false-negatives due to (i) case-sensitive matching against CSS-uppercased testimonial names, (ii) newline in About heading breaking substring match, (iii) lazy-loaded project images not yet decoded at check time, (iv) attempting shadcn portal option click on what is actually a native <select>. All resolved via improved test approach; app code is correct.
